**motion-launch-videos 2.1** adds three styles and makes every style work at 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9. Films can now have sound, overlays render with transparency for video editors, and a guide matches 18 kinds of video to the right style.

**Install or update (inside Claude Code)**
```
/plugin marketplace add Kimeur/motion-launch-videos
/plugin install motion-launch-videos@motion-launch-videos
```
Then ask, for example: *"A 9:16 product reel from these shots"*, *"Caption this podcast clip for Reels"*, or *"A lower third for our host as a transparent .mov"*.

**New styles**
| Skill | Makes |
|---|---|
| `motion-photo` | product and photo reels from your own images: Ken Burns crops, parallax cutouts, carousels, a before/after slider, mosaics, price and feature tags |
| `motion-captions` | captioned clips from your own voice-over, podcast or interview: pop captions, a karaoke line, subtitles or an audiogram, every word on the frame it is said |
| `motion-overlays` | lower thirds, title and chapter cards, social handles, end screens, corner bugs and callouts, delivered as ProRes 4444 and WebM with alpha |

**Every style, every format.** `--format 9:16` (or `16:9`, `4:5`) renders the same film laid out for that frame, not cropped. A new composition check catches content left in one corner.

**Sound.** Your own music or voice-over, mixed with sound effects generated from the film's own accents, normalised to a loudness target and checked.

**Video types.** `video-types.md` covers the feature highlight, what's new, app store preview, testimonial, event promo, countdown, intro and outro, ad and more: length, formats, beats and the styles that fit, plus each platform's safe zones.

**Also:** a stricter seamless-loop check, CI on every push, and fixes (see the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Kimeur/motion-launch-videos/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)).

**Requirements:** Node 20+, ffmpeg with libx264 (AAC for sound; prores_ks and libvpx-vp9 for transparent output), a Chromium. `render.mjs doctor` checks everything.
